scenario: An organization is operating a enterprise workload for SageMaker Feature Store. The engineering team needs to satisfy AWS architectural best practices regarding Domain 1: Data Preparation for ML. Which architectural design fulfills these requirements with minimal operational overhead?

options.text: Implement SageMaker Feature Store using AWS recommended managed architecture with automated multi-AZ failover and IAM encryption.
Deploy self-managed EC2 instances running custom scripts to sync data without leveraging AWS native IAM authentication.
Configure AWS CloudWatch alarms with automated EventBridge targets for continuous governance of SageMaker Feature Store.
Utilize manual snapshots exported to local storage on a periodic schedule without KMS key rotation.
